rows.comment: Parrish registered seven total tackles (four solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 16-0 win over Atlanta.

rows.name: Bauer Sharp
rows.comment: Sharp went without a target while playing 19 of the Buccaneers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

rows.name: Carnell Tate
rows.comment: Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Tyjae Spears
rows.comment: Spears (knee) was a limited participant at practice Thursday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Tony Pollard
rows.comment: Pollard (finger/rest) didn't practice Thursday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
rows.comment: questionable

rows.name: JC Latham
rows.comment: Latham (finger) practiced in full Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Tommy Townsend
rows.comment: Townsend (knee) was a full participant at practice Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Jaylon Jones
rows.comment: Jones (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Cody Barton
rows.comment: Barton (concussion) did not practice Wednesday.

rows.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
rows.comment: Hill (neck) did not practice Wednesday.

rows.name: Marcus Harris
rows.comment: Harris (ankle) practiced in full Wednesday.

rows.name: James Williams Sr.
rows.comment: The Titans placed Williams (groin) on injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Dorian Mausi
rows.comment: The Titans activated Mausi (foot) from injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Nicholas Singleton
rows.comment: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Singleton is "getting better," and the rookie running back could be a candidate to see added opportunities in the second half of the season if lead back Tony Pollard is dealt ahead of Tuesday's deadline, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

rows.name: Calvin Ridley
rows.comment: Titans head coach Robert Saleh confirmed Monday that Ridley was involved in an "unfortunate" interaction over the weekend at Nashville International Airport that is now in the hands of law enforcement, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

rows.name: Joey Slye
rows.comment: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

rows.name: Elic Ayomanor
rows.comment: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

rows.name: Chimere Dike
rows.comment: Dike caught five of six targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

rows.name: Gunnar Helm
rows.comment: Helm caught five of nine targets for 76 yards during Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

rows.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
rows.comment: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

rows.name: Cam Ward
rows.comment: Ward completed 26 of 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He added seven rushing attempts for 41 yards, lost a fumble, ran in a two-point conversion and threw a successful two-point conversion.

rows.name: Peter Skoronski
rows.comment: Skoronski (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: John Franklin-Myers
rows.comment: Franklin-Myers (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.comment: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Austin Ekeler
rows.comment: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Rachaad White
rows.comment: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Stefon Diggs
rows.comment: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels
rows.comment: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.comment: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.

rows.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
rows.comment: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Giants but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback.

rows.name: Isaac Yiadom
rows.comment: inactive

rows.name: Tanoa Togiai
rows.comment: inactive

rows.name: Ricky Barber
rows.comment: inactive

rows.name: Sonny Styles
rows.comment: Styles recorded 13 tackles (six solo) during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

rows.name: Nick Cross
rows.comment: Cross recorded eight tackles (six solo), an interception and a fumble recovery during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

rows.name: Frankie Luvu
rows.comment: Luvu recorded 15 tackles (seven solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

rows.name: Lucas Patrick
rows.comment: Patrick (concussion) is out for Thursday's game against the Giants, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

rows.name: Treylon Burks
rows.comment: Burks (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Thursday night's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Colson Yankoff
rows.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn ruled out Yankoff (knee) for Thursday night's games against the Giants, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

rows.name: Drew Stevens
rows.comment: Stevens made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

rows.name: Van Jefferson
rows.comment: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

rows.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
rows.comment: Newton (pectoral) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

rows.name: Dyami Brown
rows.comment: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

rows.name: Daron Payne
rows.comment: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.
